summary: An auto-rickshaw driver surprises his passenger by speaking fluent English, explaining that he learns on the PW Talk app during his free time. He highlights the app's Reels-style short videos and its AI teacher, Reeva, which helps him practice without judgment. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app from Google Play.
